trailwright.config.title: TrailWright Settings
trailwright.config.remote_note: Applies to worlds you host, not this server
trailwright.config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. Off: nothing wears and no wear is added.
trailwright.config.wearMultiplier.toolti: Scales all wear. 1.0 is normal, 2.0 wears trails twice as fast, 0 stops wear. Must be 0 or more.
trailwright.config.sprintMultiplier.tool: Extra wear for a sprinting step, as a multiplier. Must be 0 or more.
trailwright.config.countMounts.tooltip: A ridden mount's steps wear the ground (horse trails).
trailwright.config.mobMultiplier.tooltip: Scales mob wear. Must be 0 or more.
trailwright.config.respectMobGriefing.to: When on and the mobGriefing gamerule is false, mobs add no wear. Players and mounts are unaffected.
trailwright.config.decayPerDay.tooltip: Wear points an untouched block loses per in-game day. Must be 0 or more.
trailwright.config.pruneIntervalTicks.to: Ticks between sweeps that drop fully recovered wear entries (20 ticks = 1 second). Must be 1 or more.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.trailwright: Trails wear into the ground where players, mounts, and mobs walk.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.trailwrig: Trails wear into the ground where players, mounts, and mobs walk: grass to dirt, then coarse dirt, or mud near water. Bone meal, brushing, or planting restores it. Rules are data-driven. Server-side; optional on clients, where it adds an F3 wear readout for ops. Runs on Forge 1.20.1 through Sinytra Connector.
